# Archive Folder

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The top-level `z` folder space in Obsidian includes Archive (inactive) notes.

## Scope note

- This includes notes that are no longer actively being used in the PKM system.

## Broader

- [Vault](../Vault/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
